Specifically, when `reference.credentialId` is set, it tries `this.calendarCredentials.filter(...)[0]`, then optionally fetches from DB, but if the DB lookup fails or `credentialFromDB.app?.slug` is missing, `credential` remains `undefined` and is still passed into `updateEvent(...)`. This unguarded call can throw (e.g., downstream `getCalendar(credential)` expecting a defined credential), causing the enclosing `try` to fall into `catch` and returning failure results for all references instead of skipping just the missing credential.
